description:
Responsibilities:  
 ● Work with Business Analysts on requirements and come up with technical design. 
 ● Build new integration as well as improving the functionality of existing ones based on Oracle SOA Suite 
 ● Work with database and middleware system administrators to troubleshoot and fix application issues 
 Requirements  

 ● Experience with the Oracle SOA Suite, XML, XSD, XSLT, JDeveloper  

 ● Experience with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), especially data mapping from and from EDI data structure. 
 ● A strong Oracle WebLogic, Java/J2EE, development background. 
 ● Well versed in SQL and PL/SQL 
 ● Experience with Oracle EBS Financials (AP, AR, GL) and SCM ( INV, PO, OM) is highly preferred. 
 ● Exposure to the business domain of supply chain management. 
 ● Experience in design, build and test Oracle Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) Suite based applications using JDeveloper 11g. 
 ● Strong understanding of the lifecycle of technical development from technical design, unit testing to user testing, to production migration. 


 Additional Info:
 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
